title: Fourier regularity
statement: For a real number $\varepsilon$ and a real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of length $n$, say that $f$ is Fourier regular at level $\varepsilon$ if every nonempty subset $S$ of the coordinate indices satisfies $|\widehat f(S)|\le\varepsilon$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of length $n$
